item.title: Apple Watch Ultra 2 drops to $549 in new sale
item.description: The Apple Watch Ultra 2 is no longer Apple's newest flagship, but it remains remarkably close to the Ultra 3. You still get the same rugged titanium build, solid battery life, a bright 3,000-nit display, and Apple's health-tracking features. For most users, the Ultra 2 delivers nearly the same experience for less.Read Entire Article

item.title: Tiny Core Linux is a minimalist distro built for speed and customization
item.description: Tiny Core Linux is one of the smallest and fastest Linux distributions, with a base image of just 24 MB. It boots quickly, runs entirely in RAM, and includes only the essentials, letting users add features through modular extensions. Like Tiny11 on Windows, Tiny Core Linux embraces an "only what you need" philosophy.Read Entire Article

item.title: Inspectors warn of critical damage to Chernobyl containment structure after alleged drone attack
item.description: United Nations experts are calling for urgent repairs to Chernobyl's New Safe Confinement, the structure built as an additional shield against radiation from the failed nuclear power plant.
